question: Under what condition can an otherwise peaceful mantra take on a fierce character?
premises: A mantra may be inherently peaceful.
A mantra can be augmented with hu/phaṭ.
Such augmentation can change its character.
inference: Even a peaceful mantra becomes fierce if adorned with hu/phaṭ.
plain_english: Even a peaceful mantra becomes fierce if it is adorned with hu/phaṭ.
